scenes.script:
Character A says: Tell me about yourself.
Character B says: Sir... can I answer in Hindi? I freeze when I have to speak English.
Character A says: Tumne 12 years English medium se padhai ki hai, right?
Character B says: Yes, sir.
Character A says: Dekho, tumne apni mother tongue actually bol kar seekhi hai, grammar books padh kar nahi. English bhi exactly isi tarah kaam karti hai. Tumhe bas ek safe space chahiye out loud practice karne ke liye.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Interviews aise chal rahe hain?
Tell me about yourself.
Sir... kya main Hindi mein answer kar sakta hoon?
English bolte waqt main freeze ho jata hoon.
12 years English medium mein padhai ki?
Apni mother tongue aapne actually bol kar seekhi.
English bhi exactly isi tarah kaam karti hai.
Aapko bas bolne ke liye ek safe space chahiye.

scenes.script:
Character A says: Isiliye main humesha Supernova app recommend karta hoon. Isme ek personal AI teacher hain, Miss Nova.
Character A says: Wo aapko koi generic lessons nahi detin. Wo aapka exact level analyze karti hain aur aapke liye ek personalized plan ready karti hain.
Character A says: Aap real-life scenarios mein bolne ki practice karte ho, jaise client calls ya interviews.
Character A says: Aur sabse best part? Aap raat ke 3 a.m. par bhi 1000 mistakes kar sakte ho. Wo bina kisi judgment ke aapko aapki apni language mein correct karti hain.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Supernova app try karo.
Personal AI teacher: Miss Nova.
Aapke liye ek personalized plan ready karti hain.
Real-life scenarios practice karo.
Raat ke 3 a.m. par bhi 1000 mistakes karo.
Aapki apni language mein correct karti hain.
Zero judgment.

scenes.script:
Character B says: But ek AI mujhe human se better kaise sikha sakta hai?
Character A says: ChatGPT toh bas ek assistant hai, par Miss Nova ek real teacher hain. Plus, 1 crore+ Indians ise already use kar rahe hain. Grammar PDFs par ghanto waste karna band karo. Just 15 minutes a day.
Character B says: Okay, main aaj hi Supernova install karunga aur bolna start karunga.
Character A says: Perfect.
scenes.on_screen_text:

parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script has been successfully localized into romanized, highly conversational, and code-mixed Hindi. The tone matches the relationship between the characters (respectful junior to senior, and warm senior to junior). All numbers, proper nouns, and product vocabulary have been preserved in English as per the global rules. No Sanskritized or bookish words were used, and the first line was kept in English as it represents a quoted interview question.
